ActorUtil = {IsRegisteredClass=function() return true end}
function string.find_last(s, p)
    local n; for i=1,#s do if s:sub(i,i)==p then n=i end end; return n
end
-- Convert "@/path/file" to "/path/".
local function DebugPathToRealPath( p )
	if not p or p:sub( 1, 1 ) ~= "@" then
		return nil
	end

	local Path = p:sub( 2 )
	local pos = Path:find_last( '/' )
	return string.sub( Path, 1, pos )
end

local function MergeTables( left, right )
	local ret = { }
	for key, val in pairs(left) do
		ret[key] = val
	end

	for key, val in pairs(right) do
		if ret[key] then
			if type(val) == "function" and
			   type(ret[key]) == "function" then
				local f1 = ret[key]
				local f2 = val
				val = function(...)
					f1(...)
					return f2(...)
				end
			else
				Warn( string.format( "%s\n\nOverriding \"%s\": %s with %s",
					 debug.traceback(), key, type(ret[key]), type(val)) )
			end
		end

		ret[key] = val
	end
	setmetatable( ret, getmetatable(left) )
	return ret
end

DefMetatable = {
	__concat = function(left, right)
		return MergeTables( left, right )
	end
}

-- This is used as follows:
--
--   t = Def.Class { table }
Def = {}
setmetatable( Def, {
	__index = function(self, Class)
		-- t is an actor definition table.  name is the type
		-- given to Def.  Fill in standard fields.
		return function(t)
			if not ActorUtil.IsRegisteredClass(Class) then
				error( Class .. " is not a registered actor class", 2 )
			end

			t.Class = Class

			local level = 2
			if t._Level then
				level = t._Level + 1
			end
			local info

			-- Sometimes info.source will be "=(tail call)" when we need the actual
			-- file something came from.
			-- So this loop climbs the stack until it reaches an actual file path
			-- or reaches end.
			repeat
				info = debug.getinfo(level,"Sl");
				if info then
					-- Source file of caller:
					local source= info.source
					t._Source= source
					-- Line number of caller:
					t._Line = info.currentline
					t._Dir= DebugPathToRealPath(source)

					-- level is incremented for the next time through the loop.  Take
					-- that into account if level is used after the loop.
					level= level + 1
				end
			until t._Dir or not info

			setmetatable( t, DefMetatable )
			return t
		end
	end,
})
local function make_root(ctor)
 local actor=ctor('ActorFrame',{OnCommand=function() end,
  ctor('Actor',{Name='yolo',InitCommand=function() end}),
  ctor('Sprite',{Name='leader',OnCommand=function() end})})
 for offset,name in ipairs({'border','badge','left','right','black','sound'}) do
  actor[#actor+offset]=ctor(offset==6 and 'Actor' or 'Sprite',{Name=name,OnCommand=function() end})
 end
 return actor
end
local function dump(label, actor)
 local order,prefix={},0
 for _,v in ipairs(actor) do if type(v)=='table' then order[#order+1]=v.Name;prefix=prefix+1 end end
 for k,v in pairs(actor) do
  if type(k)=='number' and type(v)=='table' and not(k>=1 and k<=prefix and k%1==0) then order[#order+1]=v.Name end
 end
 print(label .. ': ' .. table.concat(order,','))
 for k,v in pairs(actor) do if type(k)=='number' then print(label .. ' slot ' .. k .. ': '..v.Name) end end
end
local plain=make_root(function(class,t) return Def[class](t) end)
dump('primary',plain)
local traced=make_root(function(class,t)
 local previous=t._Level;t._Level=(previous or 1)+1
 local result=Def[class](t);result._Level=previous;return result
end)
dump('trace-wrapper',traced)

local exact=make_root(function(class, actor_def)
 local constructor=Def[class]
			local previous_level = actor_def._Level
			local result
			if rawget(actor_def, "_Level") ~= nil then
				-- Updating an existing slot does not reshape a sparse declaration.
				actor_def._Level = (previous_level or 1) + 1
				result = constructor(actor_def)
				result._Level = previous_level
			else
				-- A temporary raw key changes Lua 5.1's sparse array border and
				-- child iteration. Supply the stack adjustment through lookup;
				-- Def's constructor installs its normal metatable before returning.
				local prior = getmetatable(actor_def)
				local temporary = {}
				if prior then for key, value in pairs(prior) do temporary[key] = value end end
				local index = prior and prior.__index
				temporary.__index = function(value, key)
					if key == "_Level" then return (previous_level or 1) + 1 end
					if type(index) == "function" then return index(value, key) end
					if type(index) == "table" then return index[key] end
				end
				setmetatable(actor_def, temporary)
				result = constructor(actor_def)
			end

return result
end)
dump('exact-proposed-wrapper',exact)
